text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump! Thump! Thump-thump-thump!)
choice_data_list:
Now then, we shall begin the New Year's 
Greeting Ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha~! Thank you so much for allowing me 
an audience with my Lord~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle still goes along with play 
like this. And then...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Mirako, and Trainer! Good of you 
to show your faces so early in the new 
year!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This year, we shall seize the realm for 
ourselves! Nyahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having weathered the stormy Classic year, 
No Reason was in high spirits no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, No Reason-chan. In order to seize the 
realm this year...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Who exactly are we supposed to beat?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that is the crux of the matter. 
Trainer, bring the map of alliances here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spread out the materials I had prepared 
beforehand.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Going off how it felt facing them late 
last year... These two are definitely the 
ones to beat.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S-dono, master of the 
matchlock. And Tap Dance City-dono, leader 
of the navy.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Most likely, these two giants will stand 
in our way. And at the end of the year—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The Silent Clan, having reached the 
Classic tier this year, will surely rise 
to prominence.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lady Neo Universe, Lady Zenno Rob Roy. And 
furthermore—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lady Still in Love might come attacking as 
well, I reckon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there are so many strong-looking 
girls~... Can the two of us really win 
this on our own?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, don't you think we need a few 
more girls to train with?"
choice_data_list:
Indeed... we might be shorthanded as 
things stand.

Indeed... we might be shorthanded as 
things stand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Hishi Miracle says, without 
like-minded comrades, things might be 
pretty tough...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I don't join hands with such Umamusume 
and spur each other on, I feel like I'll 
be wiped out in no time...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is there no one out there? Someone 
who dreams of overthrowing the top, just 
like us...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come to think of it, I might know a 
girl just like that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't been feeling too sharp lately, 
and she's always saying, "I need to do 
something about this."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What?! Is that true, Mirako? Then by all 
means, bring that person to this castle at 
once!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't know if they'll come, but 
I'll go ahead and ask.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having been called over, what 
awaited was—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm Dants Flame. Um, Mirako-senpai 
told me...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I was told there was a sort of "Want to 
Try Harder Club" and asked to join, so I 
came here, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"The 'I Wanna Try Harder' Club"?! Oh, 
Mirako~, don't go giving it such a bizarre 
name.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry. I just kind of felt like 
that's what it was.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So, Lady Dantsu. Do you truly wish to give 
it your all?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes. During the Classic year, I couldn't 
stand in the center of the spotlight like 
Pokke-chan, Tachyon-chan, or Cafe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
After that, I got to be the star for just 
a moment, but it didn't last long...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Last autumn, my results weren't great 
either. There were many times I couldn't 
even contest for the win. But...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want to do something. I want to stand in 
the center again, I really do. So...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... It is smoldering, is it not? An 
ember that refuses to be extinguished...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Truly worthy of teaming up with us! Don't 
you agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dants Flame, striving for a comeback, 
seemed like she would hit it off with No 
Reason and the others.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, now! As we welcome the New Year like 
this—there is something I would like to 
ask of you all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Tell me. What race do you believe was your 
most shining moment so far?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My most dazzling race...? Umm, for me, 
it's~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho, I guess. It was my first 
G1, and the best race I've ever run.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"For me... it would be the 'Takarazuka 
Kinen', I suppose. It was a memorable GⅠ 
where I ran a truly great race."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, I see. For me, it was the Satsuki 
Sho, where I left everyone stunned. 
However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Cast away your memories! Do not dwell on 
the past. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Throw away... our memories?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm! If one merely wallows in nostalgia 
thinking about how good things used to be, 
one can never move forward.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Our brilliance must not be a fleeting one. 
It must endure for all eternity!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let future generations call me 
‘just a fluke, a fleeting bloom of the 
era’—!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Let us do this! We, the Underdog 
Alliance! We shall surely spread the 
legend of our running for generations to 
come!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: No Reason-chan...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. I don't want people saying 
I was only strong that one time...!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, then let us raise a toast of 
rallying! Raise your cups, everyone.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. What beverage should we toast 
with?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Alcohol is obviously out of the question, 
so what would be the best drink for this 
celebratory toast...?"
choice_data_list:
Amazake that makes you feel like you're 
dreaming

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Milk! I think that's a wonderful idea! 
After all, milk is simply delicious...♪"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then shall we toast with the milk 
Dantsu recommended?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Then let's toast with hot milk warmed over 
a wood fire—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle & Dantsu
text_block_list.text: —Cheeeeers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lining up together, gulping it down...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho~... Goodness me, oh my... Such a 
gentle flavor that melts right in one's 
mouth~...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Feels like me body an' soul are completely 
healed up~... Aaahh, so peaceful~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason basked in the wholesome 
richness. Right at the start of the new 
year, the three of them felt completely 
mellowed out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
An "everything included" custom drink! 
Mhm, mhm, a drink for a celebratory day 
just has to be...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's more fun when there's a mix of 
everything, right? Just like okonomiyaki!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I-Is this really okay...? I've got a bad 
feeling this is going to be something 
bizarre...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle's special New Year's 
drink was complete...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Grmph, it is like a mushy porridge... Has 
my time finally come...?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, since it's here, let's drink it. 
Ready, set...

text_block_list.name: No Reason & Dantsu
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! It is delicious! Mirako, you 
are quite capable, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I put in all kinds of fruits! 
Peaches, persimmons, strawberries, and 
cherries!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Loaded with all kinds of nutrients! 
Everything in oneâthe absolute best!!" 
his/her tone

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looked completely ruined, but was 
surprisingly delicious. And thus, the 
three of them obtained a wide variety of 
nutrients.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Amazake to put one in a dreamy mood, is 
it? Indeed, while I cannot partake in 
alcohol...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Amazake should be fine. Come, everyone, 
let us drink together beneath the stars.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, this feels mighty fine. My head's 
going all fuzzy~...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if... one day, I too can become 
an Autumn Senior Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Maybe I'll win the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), and the Takarazuka Kinen, too... 
Just kidding~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Well, as for me~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling lightheaded and floaty from the 
amazake, the three talked about their 
dreams, seeming to have grown considerably 
bold.
